name: Nicodemus
background: A Pharisee and member of the Sanhedrin who seeks the truth in secret. He is torn between his position in the Council and his growing conviction that Jesus is from God.

genericReactions.physical: One must be careful what conclusions are drawn from a single object.
genericReactions.testimonial: I came to him by night. I know he is a teacher from God.
genericReactions.digital: Does our law judge a man without first giving him a hearing?
genericReactions.environmental: The darkness is where I sought him, but he speaks of the light.
genericReactions.analytical: The council is calculating the political cost. I am calculating the spiritual one.
genericReactions.prophecy: He speaks of being born again. It is a difficult teaching.
